surveyed.source: OSM node 440673918 (Simon Carmiggelt, bust by Kees Verkade, 1988); bust read from Anefo photographs 934-3460..3464 (Rob Croes, CC0, 1988-10-25); the 2020 panoramas show only a blurred pillar; facing (150 degrees, +-45) and the pillar and bust sizes are estimates. The brief placed it on the Kloveniersburgwal; OSM and the 1988 photographs put it in the Weteringplantsoen
